name: Performance, Capacity, and Cost Governance
description: Performance budget contract, startup time baseline, memory budget, CPU and battery budget, repository indexing benchmarks, coordination throughput benchmarks, PGlite and DuckDB query benchmarks, Valkey backpressure, UI responsiveness, large workspace scenarios, multi-agent saturation, network-constrained scenarios, provider cost accounting, storage growth and compaction, capacity recommendation engine, performance regression gates, and low-end hardware qualification.
objective: Define and enforce performance budgets, capacity limits, cost governance, and regression gates across all subsystems.
